import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def _norm_sku(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return np.nan
    return str(s).strip().upper()


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    price_list = inputs["price_list"].copy()

    # ---- expression: sku_norm ----
    orders["sku_norm"] = orders["sku"].apply(_norm_sku)

    # prepare price list normalized sku for matching
    price_list = price_list.copy()
    price_list["_sku_norm_pl"] = price_list["sku"].apply(_norm_sku)

    orders = orders.reset_index(drop=True)
    orders["_idx"] = orders.index

    # ---- lookup ----
    # merge on normalized sku (NaN never matches NaN in merge, matching spec
    # that a NULL sku_norm never matches)
    merged = orders.merge(
        price_list,
        left_on="sku_norm",
        right_on="_sku_norm_pl",
        suffixes=("", "_pl"),
    )

    # condition: price_list.valid_from <= order_date
    merged = merged[merged["valid_from"] <= merged["order_date"]]

    # tie-break: greatest valid_from, then lowest list_id
    merged = merged.sort_values(
        ["_idx", "valid_from", "list_id"],
        ascending=[True, False, True],
        kind="mergesort",
    )

    best = merged.groupby("_idx").first()

    orders = orders.set_index("_idx")

    unit_price = pd.Series(index=orders.index, dtype="float64")
    unit_price.loc[best.index] = best["unit_price"].astype("float64")

    price_flag = pd.Series("NO_PRICE", index=orders.index)
    price_flag.loc[best.index] = "OK"

    unit_price = unit_price.fillna(0.0)

    orders["unit_price"] = unit_price
    orders["price_flag"] = price_flag

    # ---- expression: ext_amount ----
    orders["ext_amount"] = orders["qty"] * orders["unit_price"]

    # ---- router ----
    qty = orders["qty"]
    ext_amount = orders["ext_amount"]
    price_flag_s = orders["price_flag"]

    review_cond = (
        (price_flag_s == "NO_PRICE")
        | (qty.isna())
        | (qty >= 100)
    )
    bulk_cond = ext_amount >= 1000
    small_cond = ext_amount < 50

    review_cond = review_cond.fillna(False)
    bulk_cond = bulk_cond.fillna(False)
    small_cond = small_cond.fillna(False)

    route = np.select(
        [review_cond.values, bulk_cond.values, small_cond.values],
        ["REVIEW", "BULK", "SMALL"],
        default="STANDARD",
    )
    orders["route"] = route

    orders = orders.reset_index(drop=True)

    # ---- output1: order_enriched ----
    order_enriched = orders[["order_id", "sku_norm", "unit_price", "route"]].copy()

    # ---- aggregator ----
    grp = orders.groupby(["route", "order_date"], dropna=False)
    order_count = grp.size().rename("order_count")
    total_ext = grp["ext_amount"].apply(lambda s: s.sum() if s.notna().any() else 0.0)
    total_ext = total_ext.rename("total_ext")

    agg = pd.concat([order_count, total_ext], axis=1).reset_index()

    route_daily = agg[["route", "order_date", "order_count", "total_ext"]].copy()

    return {
        "order_enriched": order_enriched,
        "route_daily": route_daily,
    }
